exposure: Patients who underwent uterine artery embolization (n=78)
Balloon occlusion of the abdominal aorta
balloon occlusion of the abdominal aorta
cohort: 623 patients with pernicious placenta previa and placenta accreta admitted to a hospital in China from January 2013 to January 2019
finding: Balloon occlusion of the abdominal aorta combined with cesarean section is a safe and effective treatment for pernicious placenta previa with placenta accreta, resulting in successful uterine preservation in all cases and minimal complications.
